text:
Tariq: Quick flag - new hires keep hitting the quickstart with 403s. Turns out sample-app README uses RW_API_KEY but our getting-started snippets for JS/Python show REDWOOD_TOKEN.
Nina: Oof. That's a confusing divergence. Which one is the canonical var according to the config spec?
ConfigBot: Config v1.0 (internal) recommends: RW_API_KEY (primary), REDWOOD_API_KEY (legacy), REDWOOD_TOKEN (deprecated).
Sam: We should document explicit fallback order and implement in SDKs. Proposed lookup: RW_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_TOKEN -> ~/.redwood/credentials -> cloud metadata.
Liu: Also consider adding a readable diagnostic when nothing is found. Right now SDKs raise KeyError which just scares new users. Instead: "no API key found; checked: RW_API_KEY, REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_TOKEN" with a doc link.
Tariq: Agree. Also sticky point: org/project scoping. Some examples set REDWOOD_ORG in env, others rely on the service to infer org from key. We should prefer explicit env vars over inference.
Nina: If we prefer explicit scoping, we need to make sure SDKs accept both env-based and client-level overrides (e.g., Client(api_key=..., org="acme")) and document the precedence.
Sam: Rotation workflow: ops want to rotate keys without changing env vars. Suggest supporting REDWOOD_KEY_ID and sending it as header X-Redwood-Key-Id on requests. That lets load balancers map to new keys.
Liu: For long-running processes we should also surface a refresh callback in SDKs so apps can swap credentials at runtime (callback that returns new key). Add integration test for that.
Tariq: Telemetry: count when deprecated vars were used (non-identifying) so we know when to remove REDWOOD_TOKEN. Make it opt-out via RW_TELEMETRY=0.
Nina: Good. Also add a small migration note in the getting-started: "Prefer RW_API_KEY. REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_TOKEN are supported for 90 days."
Sam: I'll draft the SDK change: add utils.get_api_key() that implements lookup order, emits an optional telemetry event, and returns (key, source_tag) where source_tag is one of ["primary","legacy","deprecated","credfile","metadata"]. Tests will assert behavior.
Liu: For the sample-app quickstart, update all language snippets to use RW_API_KEY and add a troubleshooting section: common env var mismatches + how to run `export RW_API_KEY=...`.
Tariq: Who owns the doc change? Nina?
Nina: I can take docs and sample-app updates. Sam will do JS/Python SDKs. Liu will add the rotation callback change and tests.
ConfigBot: New ticket created: DE-4358 "standardize env var lookup + runtime rotation support" assigned to @Sam, @Liu, @Nina.
Tariq: Cool. One more: add a small runner test in CI that runs the quickstart with permutations of env vars so we catch future regressions (e.g., only REDWOOD_TOKEN set).
Sam: Will include that in the SDK repo's CI matrix.
Liu: Also let's add a lint rule that flags README snippets using deprecated vars. That'll help contributors.
Nina: Perfect. I'll draft the README patch and migration blurb, then ping security about the header for REDWOOD_KEY_ID format.
Tariq: Thanks team. If you hit users in the wild before this lands, tell them to set RW_API_KEY env var as a workaround.
Sam: noted and will include that in the support KB.
